infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EvidenceVault requires camera access to capture photographic evidence of documents, screens, and physical records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EvidenceVault requires photo library access to import screenshots and digital evidence for cryptographic hashing and preservation.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: EvidenceVault uses Face ID to securely unlock your offline evidence vault.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Allow EvidenceVault to use Face ID to authenticate and open your secure vault.

plugins.photosPermission: EvidenceVault needs access to your photos to preserve digital screenshots.
plugins.cameraPermission: EvidenceVault needs camera access to capture incident evidence.
